ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all Gies majors on Monday, November 18, 2024 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, November 25, 2024 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2025 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
